title: Presets: Generic + Tune RT/CLA-76
description: Implement generic ProLink presets and plugin-specific presets for Tune RT and CLA-76. Create preset definitions that map plugin parameters to controller actions. Evidence class: RUNTIME_CONFIRMED.

evidenceRequirements.description: Preset tests including plugin parameter mapping

acceptanceCriteria: Generic ProLink preset with common controller actions (switch, relative adjust)
Tune RT preset with parameter mappings (note, cents, octave, etc.)
CLA-76 preset with parameter mappings (input, output, attack, release, ratio, etc.)
Presets integrate with existing action definitions
Feedback definitions for preset parameter display
Variable definitions for preset state tracking
Tests verify preset structure and parameter mappings
